js: try{window.__guide.close()}catch(e){}; const W=window.__game, d=W.debug, T=d.tools(); d.unlockAll(); W.points=9999; const tall=W.plants.filter(p=>p.alive&&p.isTree&&p.growth>=0.5&&p.topY()-W.env.heightAt(p.x,p.z)>=10)[0]; const put=(id,x,z)=>{ const hit={x,z,y:W.env.heightAt(x,z)}; const c=T.check(id,hit); if(!c.ok) return id+':'+c.reason; T.use(id,hit,c); return id+' ok'; }; const r=[put('canopybot',tall.x,tall.z)]; for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ const s=put('lidar',Math.cos(i)*(5+i),Math.sin(i)*(5+i)); if(/ok/.test(s)){ r.push(s); break; } } d.ff(3); const S=T.serialize(); const ids=S.devices.map(x=>x.id).join(','); T.removeDevices(()=>true); const left=T.serialize().devices.length; T.restore(S,(x,z)=>W.plants.find(p=>p.alive&&p.isTree&&Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)<1.5)); d.ff(3); const back=T.serialize().devices.map(x=>x.id).join(','); r.join(' ')+' | saved '+ids+' | after remove '+left+' | restored '+back+' | json '+JSON.stringify(S.devices.filter(x=>/canopy|lidar/.test(x.id)))
